# proxmox_node_rrddata (Data Source)

Reads raw RRD metric points of a node from `GET /nodes/{node}/rrddata` and returns them as a JSON array.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_rrddata" "cpu" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  timeframe = "hour"
  cf        = "AVERAGE"
}

output "points" {
  value = jsondecode(data.proxmox_node_rrddata.cpu.data)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `timeframe` (String) `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`, `year` or `decade`.

### Optional

- `cf` (String) Consolidation function: `AVERAGE` or `MAX`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) JSON array of metric points.
